title: Physics of Estuarine and Marine Environments
description: Prerequisite: Must have completed one year of physics coursework; and must have completed one year of calculus coursework. Or permission of instructor. General introduction to the physical oceanography of estuarine and marine systems. Physical characteristics of seawater, heat and mass transport, major ocean currents, basic dynamical oceanography, surface waves, tides, turbulence, sediment transport, estuarine circulation.
